verdict.rationale: Chargebee provides a well-documented REST API with authentication, idempotency, pagination-style advanced features, an interactive API Explorer, and official SDKs, plus an llms.txt endpoint confirming machine-readable documentation surfaces. This clearly satisfies driving the product programmatically via a documented public API. Missing for 10: no independent third-party hands-on corroboration of API robustness and no confirmed OpenAPI/swagger spec discovery (probe found 404s).
